name: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA
tagline: Global leader in adhesive technologies and consumer brands with strong market positions in industrial and consumer applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Henkel's adjusted EBIT margin de 15,5% au premier semestre 2025 démontre la rentabilité opérationnelle solide et l'efficacité de la gestion des coûts malgré un environnement de marché difficile et une baisse des ventes nominales

kpis.explanation: Total group sales revenue for the first six months of 2025, reflecting nominal sales development across Adhesive Technologies and Consumer Brands segments.
kpis.signal: Sales decline driven by foreign exchange effects (-2.8%) and portfolio divestments (-0.9%), with organic growth flat at -0.1%
kpis.description: Henkel achieved group sales of 10,402 million euros in H1 2025, down 3.8% from 10,813 million euros in H1 2024. Organic sales growth was -0.1%, with Adhesive Technologies at +1.2% and Consumer Brands at -1.6%.

kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit margin (adjusted EBIT margin) demonstrates operational efficiency and profitability after excluding one-time expenses, restructuring costs, and other adjustments.
kpis.signal: Strong operational profitability with adjusted EBIT margin expanding by 60 basis points year-over-year despite challenging market conditions
kpis.description: Adjusted return on sales (adjusted EBIT margin) reached 15.5% in H1 2025, up 0.6 percentage points from 14.9% in H1 2024. Adhesive Technologies achieved 17.2% and Consumer Brands 15.3%.

kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit excluding one-time expenses, income adjustments, and restructuring costs to show underlying operational performance.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBIT essentially flat year-over-year, indicating stable underlying operational performance despite headwinds from currency and portfolio changes
kpis.description: Adjusted operating profit (adjusted EBIT) was 1,614 million euros in H1 2025 compared to 1,610 million euros in H1 2024, representing marginal growth of 0.2%.

kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to shareholders of Henkel AG & Co. KGaA for the first half of 2025, reflecting total profitability after all expenses, taxes, and non-controlling interests.
kpis.signal: Net income growth of 7.9% demonstrates improving bottom-line profitability despite flat organic sales, benefiting from improved operational efficiency and financial management
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders reached 1,110 million euros in H1 2025, up 7.9% from 1,029 million euros in H1 2024.

kpis.name_en: Adjusted Earnings Per Share First Half 2025
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per preferred share excluding one-time expenses and restructuring costs, showing underlying per-share profitability. Development at constant exchange rates shows +5.0%.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EPS growth of 5.0% at constant exchange rates demonstrates underlying earnings strength, with reported growth of 1.1% impacted by currency headwinds
kpis.description: Adjusted earnings per preferred share was 2.81 euros in H1 2025 compared to 2.78 euros in H1 2024, representing growth of 1.1%. At constant exchange rates, growth reached 5.0%.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the H1 2025 half-year financial report. The organization focuses on traditional adhesive technologies, consumer brands, and operational efficiency improvements.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, automation, digital transformation, or related emerging technologies in the interim management report or financial statements
